items.title: saudi air defences down two missiles aimed at taif and yanbu
items.summary:
the saudi-led coalition says it destroyed two houthi ballistic missiles fired on saturday, aimed at the cities of taif and yanbu.
alerts went out in four areas before saudi authorities said the danger had passed.
items.change: the salvo came in daylight and was aimed at taif and yanbu rather than riyadh; officials lifted the alerts in four areas by mid-morning.

items.title: us embassies tighten security as iran's plotting warning hardens
items.summary:
embassies across the region went on heightened alert after a dni memo said iran has 'substantially increased efforts' to target american personnel.
the state department also added the houthi missile threat to its israel travel advisory, keeping the level at 3.
items.change: the state department folded the houthi threat into its israel advisory on saturday, a day after the dni memo reached rubio.

items.title: iran says us warships will not be allowed back into the gulf
items.summary:
iran's armed forces chief says washington 'can only dream' of sending ships into the persian gulf, answering trump's 'another little epic fury' remark at a florida rally.
ali abdollahi said iran can hit any vessel in the region, as the irgc claimed two more tankers struck mines.
items.change: tehran answered the rally threat on the record, with its general staff saying the gulf is closed to us warships.

meta.spokesman: Ali Abdollahi, chief of general staff

items.title: israel razes a hebron neighbourhood and seals the west bank
items.summary:
israeli troops levelled a hebron neighbourhood and sealed the city of 250,000 on saturday, a day after two soldiers were killed at a checkpoint.
the hebron mayor says about 2,200 people were displaced; the municipality counted 1,500 by the afternoon, with 35 hectares razed or marked.
items.change: the demolitions went from threatened to done overnight, and the whole west bank is under closure four days before the election.

items.title: nine killed at a jordan church funeral as the gunmen stay free
items.summary:
jordan's toll rose to nine dead and 40 injured after gunmen opened fire at a funeral in hamoud, karak, and police are still hunting three attackers.
state tv aired cctv of them firing from the pavement; king abdullah ordered a review of how the security response was handled.
items.change: the death toll rose from seven to nine while cctv of the three gunmen was released and the manhunt carried on.

items.title: taiz's hospital warns it collapses in days; the houthis hit aden
items.summary:
the main hospital in besieged taiz warns it will collapse within days, and drinking water is down to rationing for the city's 800,000 people.
the houthis also fired ballistic missiles at aden on saturday, saying they hit the al-nasr camp and the naval base.
items.change: aden came under ballistic missile fire while taiz's hospital warned of collapse, so the war is now running on two fronts at once.

items.title: israel votes on tuesday and trump's team is already planning past netanyahu
items.summary:
the last maariv poll puts the opposition on 54 seats to netanyahu's 48, with neither bloc able to govern alone.
trump advisers told axios they are optimistic about working with netanyahu's rivals, while jd vance declined to repeat the president's endorsement.
items.change: trump's own advisers went public about planning for a post-netanyahu israel, three days out from the ballot.

items.title: istanbul opens a trial of netanyahu and 34 other israelis
items.summary:
a turkish court began hearing the case over the sumud flotilla interception, with none of the 35 defendants in the room.
judges ordered checks on their property in turkey, upheld arrest warrants and asked prosecutors to weigh new charges over gaza.
items.change: the first hearing widened the case past the flotilla, with judges asking prosecutors to weigh new charges over gaza.

items.title: wall street ends the week lower as the ai trade wobbles
items.summary:
the s&p fell 0.52% to 7,623.68 on friday and 0.47% on the week; the nasdaq lost 0.21% to 25,955.34 and 0.71% on the week.
the dow slipped 1.24% on friday but still gained 0.41% for the week; the vix closed at 19.45.

items.title: nvidia's role as the ai financier hits its first stress test
items.summary:
nvidia carries $36bn of off-balance-sheet backstops for neoclouds plus a guarantee of up to $105bn for openai's ohio site, and the credit market is now pricing the risk.
coreweave, nebius and iren are down at least 30% this month, coreweave's cds spread is past 11%, and firmus pulled its ipo.

items.title: oil closes at a six-month high on iran war fears
items.summary:
brent settled at $116.72, up 3.1%, and wti at $103.27, up 3.8%, as traders bet on new us strikes on iran.
brent gained 6.2% this week, its third straight weekly rise; no trading again until monday.

items.title: a fed decision and three megacap reports land this week
items.summary:
the fed decides on wednesday, with q3 gdp and september pce due thursday and microsoft, alphabet and amazon reporting wednesday and thursday.
alphabet enters its print down 6%, and exxon and chevron close the week on friday.

items.title: berkshire closes at records and erases the buffett discount
items.summary:
the a shares closed thursday at $820,500 and the b shares at $546.97, both all-time highs, recovering everything lost when buffett said he would step down.
the b shares are up almost 9% in october while the s&p is down 0.4%, as money rotates out of ai names into $350bn of cash.

items.title: france's borrowing costs hit a 2002 high as the protests spread
items.summary:
french bond yields reached their highest since 2002 this week, with the budget fight resuming in the national assembly on october 27.
moody's kept france at aa3 on friday but held its negative outlook, citing a fragmented parliament.

items.title: amgen's lung cancer combo cuts death risk by 58%
items.summary:
full late-stage results released on saturday show imdelltra plus astrazeneca's imfinzi cut the risk of death by 58% in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.
median survival went to 21.1 months from 12.7, a rare big step in a cancer that usually returns within months.

items.title: lkq drops 22% on weak preliminary results and a leadership shake-up
items.summary:
the auto-parts distributor closed at $17.42, down 22.5%, after preliminary third-quarter figures came in soft.
it also ousted its chief executive and warned of a third-quarter shortfall, one of friday's worst large-cap moves.

items.title: brighton at anfield sunday, with brighton third and liverpool fifth
items.summary:
liverpool host brighton at 14:00 uk on sunday (17:00 riyadh) without szoboszlai, frimpong and with munoz a doubt, and gravenberch banned.
brighton arrive two places above the reds, and liverpool have won three in a row for the first time under iraola.

items.title: brighton bring the league's best defence and 23 goals in seven
items.summary:
brighton have scored 23 goals in seven league games and kept five clean sheets, the joint-best defensive record with arsenal.
liverpool have shipped 10 in their last four matches, after conceding twice in five before the last international break.

items.title: iraola says wirtz is judged on body language, not output
items.summary:
iraola defended wirtz after his first goal of the season against villarreal, saying the midfielder is being read harshly because of how he carries himself.
wirtz, a £116m signing, has 21 goal contributions in 59 liverpool games and is expected to start against brighton.

items.title: crouch says ngumoha is now undroppable for sunday
items.summary:
peter crouch called rio ngumoha liverpool's best player right now and said he has to start on the right against brighton.
the 18-year-old has featured in nine of 11 games under iraola and set up two goals against villarreal.

items.title: liverpool weigh an early january recall for ndukwe
items.summary:
ifeanyi ndukwe's representatives are due to hold talks about cutting his levante loan short in january, after a strong start in la liga.
he left on loan because he could not get a uk work permit and liverpool had used its quota of non-eligible players.

meta.reliability: reported - Liverpool Echo, no club confirmation

items.title: frimpong is out until after the november break
items.summary:
iraola says frimpong's muscle injury will keep him out until after the november international break, with palace away on november 8 the target.
szoboszlai is back in personal training but not available; munoz has a knee knock and is a doubt.

meta.reliability: club press conference via Liverpool Echo

items.title: panel backs gravenberch's red card, so brighton is a no-go
items.summary:
the premier league's key match incidents panel said chris kavanagh was right to send off ryan gravenberch against man city, by a 4-1 vote.
two yellows mean he misses the brighton game; iraola called the first caution 'never a yellow'.

items.title: chelsea visit in the league cup on wednesday
items.summary:
liverpool host chelsea at 20:00 uk time on wednesday in the league cup, three days after brighton.
it is the second home game in four days, after brighton on sunday.
